Build succeeded with 0 warnings and 0 errors. Here's what was created:

**Project structure:**
```
RecipeSharingApp/
├── Models/Recipe.cs          # Recipe, Category, RecipeSubmission models
├── Services/RecipeService.cs # In-memory data store with seed recipes
├── Components/
│   ├── StarRating.razor      # Interactive star-rating widget (Server mode)
│   ├── Layout/MainLayout.razor  # Nav bar + footer
│   └── Pages/
│       ├── Home.razor            # Homepage with category cards (static SSR)
│       ├── Categories.razor      # Browse all categories (static SSR)
│       ├── CategoryRecipes.razor # Recipes in a category (static SSR)
│       ├── RecipeDetail.razor    # Recipe page with StarRating component
│       └── SubmitRecipe.razor    # Form to submit recipes (Server mode)
└── wwwroot/app.css           # Full app styling
```

**Key design decisions:**
- **Per-component interactivity** — only `StarRating` and `SubmitRecipe` use `@rendermode InteractiveServer`; all other pages render as static SSR for fast load times
- **Singleton `RecipeService`** — acts as an in-memory store with 6 seed recipes across 4 categories
- **Star rating** — hover preview, click-to-rate (one rating per session), updates average in real time
- **Submit form** — validates all fields, shows success message with link to the new recipe

Run with `dotnet run --project RecipeSharingApp` to start the app.
